class_evidence_vocabulary.caption_material_specific: caption names a specific material of the class (e.g. PET, stainless steel, glazed ceramic)
class_evidence_vocabulary.caption_material_generic: caption names only the material family (plastic, metal, wood)
class_evidence_vocabulary.caption_material_conflict: caption names a material of another class; class kept on other evidence (see evidence)
class_evidence_vocabulary.caption_identity_only: caption or description identifies the object but names no material
class_evidence_vocabulary.caption_mismatch: caption describes a different object than the category; not used as evidence
class_evidence_vocabulary.no_caption: no description.json at HF (404); class from category, bbox and mass only
class_evidence_vocabulary.caption_names_product: caption names a branded product whose packaging material is known
class_evidence_vocabulary.real_robot_frames: class from real-robot frames of the task

pet_plastic.description: Thin-wall rigid PET: smooth glossy polymer surface, bulk PET (about 1380 kg/m3); hollow drink bottles. Assigned only where the caption names PET, shows clarity or identifies a PET-bottled product; "plastic" alone is not evidence of PET.

abs_toy_plastic.description: ABS/PS/PVC-type hard moulded plastic as used in toys, tokens, figures and tiles: smooth glossy to satin surface, solid or thick shell (about 1050 kg/m3).

abs_device_housing.description: ABS/PC consumer-electronics and appliance shells: satin or textured plastic surface over a hollow body holding PCBs and batteries; mass dominated by internals.

polyolefin_plastic.description: PP/HDPE/LDPE containers, tubes, films and tools: waxy low-friction semi-gloss surface, bulk 910-960 kg/m3; hollow packaging and bins. Kept as one class: available friction sources do not separate PP from PE. Per-model polymer_subtype records pp/pe where a caption or the real frames state it.

softwood.description: Painted or lacquered softwood (linden/pine/basswood): sealed-grain wood surface, bulk 400-550 kg/m3.

hardwood.description: Hardwood (beech/ash/maple/bamboo): dense sealed or oiled wood surface, bulk 600-800 kg/m3.

engineered_wood.description: MDF/plywood/particleboard with laminate or paint: smooth composite surface, bulk 600-800 kg/m3; furniture and boxes.

glazed_ceramic.description: Glazed porcelain/stoneware: glassy hard glaze over ceramic body, bulk about 2300-2500 kg/m3; tableware and vessels.

glass.description: Soda-lime or borosilicate glass: smooth hard surface, bulk about 2500 kg/m3; thin-wall hollow vessels.

steel.description: Steel/stainless/brass hand tools, cutlery, fasteners, cookware: bare or plated metal surface, bulk 7800 kg/m3 (brass 8500).

aluminium.description: Aluminium alloy bodies, stands and cans: anodised or bare metal surface, bulk 2700 kg/m3; thin-wall cans are hollow.

rubber_elastomer.description: Rubber/TPR/PVC elastomer: high-friction compliant surface, bulk 900-1500 kg/m3; belts, erasers, balls.

paper_cardboard.description: Paper, card, corrugated board, banknotes, laminated pouches: fibrous matte surface, bulk 700-1000 kg/m3 (sheet) or hollow carton.

foam.description: Soft polyurethane/EVA/polyester foam or stuffed cushions: compliant, high-friction surface, bulk 30-300 kg/m3.

fabric_textile.description: Woven or knitted cloth, leather and plush: compliant, high-friction textile surface; garments are cloth particles, not rigid bodies.

food_organic.description: Real food (bread, fruit, chocolate, noodles): variable surfaces, hydrated organic bulk about 300-1100 kg/m3.

liquid.description: Liquid (ethanol-water spirit) simulated as particles; no solid contact surface.

mixed_unclear.description: Multi-material or unidentifiable objects (resin ornaments, PCB assemblies, plant models, watches): no single contact material can be assigned; any value is a guess.

pad_hard.description: Gripper finger face: smooth hard thermoplastic (dark grey), per Bo's reading of real ARX X5 frames; moderate confidence.

pad_elastomer.description: Gripper finger face with adhered silicone/rubber/TPU grip pad (Shore A 60-90).

table_laminate.description: Table top: smooth white melamine/laminate board.

table_wood.description: Table top: finished/lacquered mahogany or hardwood (matches the simulation visual shader).

ground.description: Floor under the table (layout Ground prim, material_0564). Real floor material is unidentified. Layout declares static=dynamic friction 1.0, restitution 0.0, both combine modes "multiply".
